Overview

Turnhout is a city in Antwerp with a population of 46,000. The capital of the Kempen region, known for its printing and playing card industry, historic castle, and surrounding nature reserves. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
